ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism shown in the diagram is a secondary consumer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food web with labeled organisms including duck, mongoose, lizard, plants, fish, algae, ants, cockroach, earthworm, and decomposing stuff. Blue arrows connect the organisms; ants are shown connected with decomposing stuff, and the lizard is shown in a feeding relationship with ants. Reasoning: A secondary consumer is an organism that eats primary consumers. In this diagram, ants act as primary consumers/detritivores because they feed on decomposing organic matter. The lizard eats ants, so the lizard is the secondary consumer.
